about: EVERY NUMBER IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER until club staff confirm the real values (see CLAUDE.md). Minutes. checkInOpensMinutesBefore: someone can be checked in from this long before the start. noShowAfterEndMinutes: a boat or space booking, or a class chair, that nobody checked in for becomes a no-show this long after it ends (0 means the moment it ends). Change a number here and the check-in screens and the automatic no-show follow.
